verdict.rationale: The pack indirectly suggests the public guidance pages are readable without a key or login. Content was extracted from deep pages such as the e-services and Forms & Official Fees pages, and the llms.txt probe got a normal HTTP 404 from the server rather than a bot-wall or challenge page. No probe directly confirms access with a standard identified user agent, or the absence of a CAPTCHA or JS-only shell, so the capability is inferred, not demonstrated. Missing for 10: an explicit fetch probe of guidance pages with an identified agent UA showing server-rendered HTML, confirmation of no CAPTCHA or bot wall, and independent hands-on corroboration.
